about: The popular tool for installing and switching between versions of Node.js.

prs.title: The installer writes a working path outside the home folder
prs.broken: The installer treated any folder starting with the home path as inside it. A home of /home/me and nvm in /home/me2 wrote a broken path, so nvm did not load.
prs.changed: It now writes the home shortcut only when nvm really is inside the home folder, and the full path otherwise.
prs.matters: nvm loads in new shells, including in containers whose user has no home folder.
